items.title: Finland Arrests Two Cargo Ship Crew Members Over Undersea Cable Damage
items.description: Finnish authorities have detained all 14 crew members of a cargo vessel suspected of deliberately damaging an undersea telecommunications cable connecting Helsinki to Estonia. The ship, named Fitburg, was sailing from St. Petersburg, Russia, to Haifa, Israel, under a St. Vincent and the Grenadines flag when the incident occurred. items.title: VVS Stealer Uses PyArmor Obfuscation to Evade Static Analysis and Signature Detection
items.description: The cybersecurity landscape is witnessing a rise in sophisticated malware that leverages legitimate tools to mask malicious intent. A prime example is VVS Stealer (also styled VVS $tealer). This Python-based malware family has been actively marketed on Telegram since April 2025.
